title: THE THERMAL FIXED POINT: T_b = m sqrt(G M_b a0)/(2 k_B), the half-exponent elasticity d ln T/d ln M_b = 1/2, and the scale-invariant fluctuation floor deltaT_rms = sqrt(G m^3 a0)/(2 k_B) = 2.47e-36 K -- certified in Lean (zero sorry, axioms {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound})

field_identity.statement: T_b = m sigma^2/k_B with sigma^2 = (1/2) sqrt(G M_b a0)  =>  T_b = m sqrt(G M_b a0)/(2 k_B)

power_law_form.statement: T = (m/2k_B) sqrt(G a0) sqrt(M_b) -- T_b is M_b^{1/2} times an M_b-free constant
power_law_form.provides: T_b ∝ M_b^{+1/2} at the field-algebra level (sqrt split)

log_half_slope.statement: ln T = ln(m/2k_B) + (1/2)(ln(G a0) + ln M_b) -- the log-log slope in ln M_b is EXACTLY 1/2
log_half_slope.provides: the half-exponent elasticity at the algebra level

elasticity_half.statement: d/dM_b ln T = 1/(2 M_b), hence d ln T/d ln M_b = M_b (dT/dM_b)/T = 1/2 (Hadamard elasticity, HasDerivAt)
elasticity_half.provides: the literal differential form of the half-exponent elasticity

n_inv_half.provides: the N^{-1/2} algebra of the heat-capacity floor

fluct_closed_form.statement: T_b * sqrt(m/M_b) = sqrt(G m^3 a0)/(2 k_B) -- the closed form of the rms fluctuation
fluct_closed_form.provides: deltaT_rms = sqrt(G m^3 a0)/(2 k_B): M_b-free (scale-invariant at fixed m, a0)

fluct_scale.statement: from N = M_b/m and deltaT/T = N^{-1/2}: deltaT_rms = sqrt(G m^3 a0)/(2 k_B) -- the FULL chain
fluct_scale.provides: the N^{-1/2} fluctuation law end to end

num_dT_rms_interval.statement: deltaT_rms in (2.4732e-36, 2.4733e-36) K (squared-interval technique, exact rationals)
num_dT_rms_interval.provides: the B05 register value 2.4732201374593863e-36 K pinned to 1e-5

num_Tb_canon_interval.statement: T_b (M_b = 7.0e10 M_sun) in (9.68, 9.70) K (squared-interval technique, exact rationals)
num_Tb_canon_interval.provides: the B05 canonical register value 9.689175 K pinned to 2e-3

numeric.scale_invariance: dT_rms = sqrt(G m^3 a0)/(2 k_B) carries no M_b: T ~ a0 r_M and N ~ r_M^2 cancel, the same 2.47e-36 K floor for every halo at fixed (m, a0) -- verified numerically at the 6.5e10 M_sun anchor (T_a/sqrt(N_a) = 2.4732201374593870e-36 K, the closed form)
numeric.half_exponent: T_b ∝ M_b^{+1/2}: M_b x2 -> T_b x sqrt(2) = x1.4142 (exponent EXACTLY 1/2 at the algebra level)

statement: The three theorems of the thermal fixed point -- (1) the field identity T_b = m sqrt(G M_b a0)/(2 k_B), (2) the half-exponent elasticity d ln T/d ln M_b = 1/2 (power-law form + log-log slope + differential form), (3) the N^{-1/2} fluctuation scale deltaT_rms = sqrt(G m^3 a0)/(2 k_B) -- are machine-certified; the numeric floors (2.47e-36 K, 9.69 K) are pinned by exact rational interval arithmetic. Lean certifies the mathematics; the physical reading (the sector temperature stays at the equilibrium value, the scatter is 100% non-thermal) is the committed lanes' claim (B05/B08/G135).
